why_this_works: Browning the sausage first renders fat that you then use to saute the onion, building a fond that adds depth to what is essentially a box rice mix. Adding the shrimp and peas at the very end keeps the shrimp from turning rubbery and the peas from going army-green. The Zatarain's yellow rice handles the saffron-turmeric flavor so you get paella vibes without the price tag.
notes: Prep: 10 min, Cook: 30 min. Serves 8. Quick weeknight crowd-feeder.

ingredients: 1/2 package Cajun style smoked sausage, halved lengthwise and sliced 1/4-inch thick
1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
steps: Brown the sliced sausage in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Remove and set aside.
Sauté the onion in the same pan using the rendered sausage fat until softened, about 3-5 minutes.
Add water and diced tomatoes (undrained). Bring to a boil.
Stir in the Zatarain's Yellow Rice Mix. Return the sausage to the pan.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 20 minutes until rice is nearly tender.
Stir in shrimp and frozen peas. Cover and cook 5-7 minutes until shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Remove from heat, sprinkle with parsley flakes, fluff with a fork, and serve.
